en.title: The participle
en.summary: English has a present participle in -ing and a past participle.

paragraphs: A participle is a verb form that works as part of a verb or as an adjective. English has a present participle (-ing) and a past participle (-ed, or irregular).
The present participle forms the continuous tenses. The past participle forms the perfect tenses and the passive. Both can describe a noun.

blocks.html:
ParticipleUseExample
present (-ing)continuous, adjectiveHe is running. a running tap
